messages.subject: SEM analysis
parts:
I have an ordinal mediator in my model.
I saw that lavaan dont support for MLR estimator with ordinal data there is any other way to get AICc values for this kind of model?

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: SEM analysis
parts: is any other way to get AICc values for this kind of model?

AICc is only defined for univariate regression models anyway.  But information criteria in general will only be available when using a likelihood estimator rather than a least-squares estimator.  You can compare nonnested models using incremental fit indices, assuming the same null model is nested within all competing models:

http://dx.doi.org/10.1037/1082-989X.8.1.16

http://dx.doi.org/10.1037/0033-2909.88.3.588

If you need an alternative to the independence model for this to be the case, then you can fit your own null model and pass it to the fitMeasures() function

?fitMeasures
